🔥🇲🇽 <u>ALITO'S CIRCLE SHRINKS: TWO MORE OPERATORS JAILED</u>

Two ex-officials from Alito Moreno's Campeche government (2015-2019) were arrested within 48 hours for embezzlement — among them Luis Antonio Espinosa Campos, accountant for companies tied to the PRI leader's own brother, now behind bars in San Francisco Kobén.

With the state fiscalía pursuing an 83.5-million-peso embezzlement case and desafuero on the table, Alito cries 'judicial terrorism.' The case files say otherwise.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>RECORD: HOMICIDES DOWN 51% IN UNDER TWO YEARS</u>

Intentional homicide in Mexico has fallen 51% in 23 months — from 86.9 daily cases to 42.5, a historic low.

The neoliberal 'war on drugs' filled graves and gave Washington an excuse. A strategy built on attending to root causes, intelligence work and zero impunity is doing what the tanks and the press conferences never could.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>T-MEC REVIEW: MEXICO SAYS NO MORE TARIFFS</u>

Marcelo Ebrard put Mexico's opening bid on the table: no new tariffs while the USMCA review runs — and cut the 25% duty on Mexican-made vehicles, when Japan, South Korea, Germany and Morocco pay just 15%. No auto industry on earth uses more US-made parts than Mexico's.

On steel, hit with a 50% tariff, Mexico actually runs a trade deficit with the US. Mexico's delegation is in Washington every single week making the case.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>MEXICO AT THE DEA TABLE: COORDINATION, NOT SUBORDINATION</u>

While Washington floats land operations against cartels, Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch sat down at a DEA meeting and showed Mexico's receipts: 20 intentional homicides on August 13, the lowest daily count in at least 15 years — and 21 states, including CDMX, Jalisco and Nuevo León, reported zero.

Sheinbaum's formula for dealing with Trump: coordination, not subordination.

<u>SILENCE</u>: Mexico's Colombia earthquake aid — and a Plan México week
August 8 – 14, 2026 | 🔴

📰 What US media didn't cover 🇲🇽: Mexico was among the first and largest responders to Colombia's earthquake — 58.8 tonnes of aid accepted, its elite rescue brigade refused. Same week: Sheinbaum sat down with Goldman Sachs COO John Waldron on Plan México investment, and tourism came in up 7.7%. 🔍 BBC and AP covered the quake extensively. Mexico's role in it: zero mentions.

No US link to share — the absence is the story.
